item.title: Trump says Iran war objectives 'nearing completion' in address to nation
item.summary: Trump's first televised address of the conflict with Iran did little to quell uneasy markets.

item.title: Israel intensifies Lebanon attacks and hits areas not in Hezbollah's control
item.summary: Attacks have continued as Israel has announced its intention to control swathes of south Lebanon.

item.title: Iran war economic shocks will last 'months', says Australia's PM
item.summary: Anthony Albanese used a rare TV address to tell Australians that the "months ahead may not be easy" amid the global effects of the war.

item.title: Israel says it will keep control over part of southern Lebanon after war with Hezbollah ends
item.summary: Defence Minister Israel Katz also says houses in Lebanese villages near the Israeli border will be demolished.

item.title: Judge temporarily halts construction of Trump's White House ballroom
item.summary: The Republican-appointed judge ruled that Trump was a "steward" of the White House, not the owner.

item.title: US journalist Shelly Kittleson kidnapped in Baghdad
item.summary: The US state department says a suspect in her abduction has ties to an Iran-backed militia group, Kataib Hezbollah.

item.title: Explosions at Burundi ammunition depot kill civilians, witnesses say
item.summary: Powerful blasts destroyed homes and sparked panic in the city of Bujumbura on Tuesday night.

item.title: Utah teen identified as victim of serial killer Ted Bundy
item.summary: New DNA testing has solved the 51-year-old case of murdered teenager Laura Ann Aime, according to investigators.

item.title: US Supreme Court appears sceptical of US birthright citizenship challenge
item.summary: Trump attended the oral arguments in person on Wednesday, a rare move by a sitting president that underscored the high stakes of the case.

item.title: Mass robotaxi malfunction halts traffic in Chinese city
item.summary: Baidu has not responded to a request for comment about the outage, which affected at least 100 cars.
